title: 71% Of Earth's Ocean Floor Is Still Unmapped
hook: Most of the ground beneath our ocean remains unseen.
closing: The largest unexplored surface nearby is not in space; it is beneath Earth's ocean.
question: Explore the ocean or Mars?

segments.say: Only 28.7% of the ocean floor meets modern mapping standards. Most remains unresolved.
Mars is 99.5% mapped. A distant planet is nearly complete while Earth's seafloor remains mostly blank.
The unmapped ocean floor covers 257 million square kilometers. That exceeds the entire surface of Mars.
